interpretations: For each race, average the season-to-date `wins` values of all drivers with a `driverStandings` row for that race. Average those race figures within each circuit country. Keep countries whose figures exceed the unweighted mean of all country figures and also exceed the unweighted mean of the first group. Report each country’s figure and its absolute differences from both means
Use only drivers who participated in a race when calculating that race’s average `driverStandings.wins`; apply the same country and group comparisons

Calculate each country’s figure from its race averages, but use the mean of **all race averages** as the overall threshold and the mean of race averages in above-threshold countries as the group threshold. Report each country’s differences from those thresholds

Use the unweighted mean of country figures as the overall threshold, but use the mean of **all race averages in above-average countries** as the group threshold. Report each country’s differences from those thresholds
Apply the unweighted country-level comparisons, but report “how far above” each mean as a percentage of that mean rather than as an absolute difference

Use the mean of all race averages as the overall threshold, but use the unweighted mean of country figures in the above-average group as the group threshold. Report absolute differences from both thresholds
queries:
WITH race_figures AS (
    SELECT ds.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS figure
    FROM driverStandings AS ds
    GROUP BY ds.raceId
),
country_figures AS (
    SELECT c.country, AVG(rf.figure) AS figure
    FROM race_figures AS rf
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = rf.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY c.country
),
all_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(figure) AS value
    FROM country_figures
),
first_group_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(cf.figure) AS value
    FROM country_figures AS cf
    CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am
    WHERE cf.figure > am.value
)
SELECT
    cf.country,
    cf.figure,
    ABS(cf.figure - am.value) AS difference_from_all_mean,
    ABS(cf.figure - fgm.value) AS difference_from_first_group_mean
FROM country_figures AS cf
CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am
CROSS JOIN first_group_mean AS fgm
WHERE cf.figure > am.value
  AND cf.figure > fgm.value;

WITH race_averages AS (
    SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(res.points) AS race_average
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_figures AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(race_average) AS country_figure
    FROM race_averages
    GROUP BY country
),
overall_threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(race_average) AS value
    FROM race_averages
),
group_threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(ra.race_average) AS value
    FROM race_averages AS ra
    JOIN country_figures AS cf ON cf.country = ra.country
    CROSS JOIN overall_threshold AS ot
    WHERE cf.country_figure > ot.value
)
SELECT
    cf.country,
    cf.country_figure,
    cf.country_figure - ot.value AS overall_difference,
    cf.country_figure - gt.value AS group_difference
FROM country_figures AS cf
CROSS JOIN overall_threshold AS ot
CROSS JOIN group_threshold AS gt
